official_sources.title: HM Land Registry plans: boundaries (practice guide 40, supplement 3)

verified_facts: INSPIRE polygons show indicative extent and position of registered freehold properties in England and Wales
the current INSPIRE dataset was published 5 July 2026
new INSPIRE files are published on the first Sunday of every month
downloads are organised by local authority
a GIS is required to view downloaded INSPIRE Index Polygons
downloads are subject to Open Government Licence conditions
general-boundary guidance distinguishes legal boundary issues from mapped physical features
general boundaries are the normal registration basis for most titles
precise legal boundary position can be difficult to show on plans
INSPIRE geometry must not be treated as an exact legal boundary merely because it is polygonal
monthly source vintage should be pinned before candidate geometry is used
quality_effect: Require current monthly HMLR INSPIRE vintage and local-authority provenance while preserving its indicative/general-boundary semantics; never promote polygon edges to an exact legal boundary without stronger evidence.
